scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:site && npm run build:sdk:package && vue-tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.typecheck: vue-tsc --noEmit && npm run typecheck:site && tsc --noEmit -p sdk/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:frontend: npm run typecheck && npm run test:unit && npm run build:ci && npm run build-storybook && npm run test:e2e:legacy && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:a11y
scripts.lint: eslint src sdk site tests .storybook playwright*.config.ts vite.config.ts vite.sdk.config.ts vite.sdk.package.config.ts vite.site.config.ts scripts --max-warnings 0
scripts.build:ci: npm run build:sdk:ci && npm run build:site:ci && npm run build:app:ci
scripts.build:sdk: tsc --noEmit -p sdk/tsconfig.json && vite build --config vite.sdk.config.ts && node scripts/apply-copyright-header.mjs ../api/app/site_assets/derridai-sdk.js
scripts.build:sdk:package: tsc -p sdk/tsconfig.build.json && vite build --config vite.sdk.package.config.ts && node scripts/apply-copyright-header.mjs sdk/dist/index.js
scripts.check:sdk:package: npm run build:sdk:package && node -e "import('./sdk/dist/index.js').then((m) => { if (typeof m.createClient !== 'function') process.exit(1); })" && npm pack ./sdk --dry-run --silent && npm run check:sdk:consumer
scripts.build:sdk:ci: npm run build:sdk:check && npm run check:sdk:package
scripts.build:site: npm run typecheck:site && vite build --config vite.site.config.ts && node scripts/apply-copyright-header.mjs ../api/app/site_assets/derridai-site.js
